core_obligations: One direction is immediate because base change preserves finite type (proof lines 31669-31670).

For the converse take finitely many generators of the base change, expand them as finite sums, let A be the subalgebra of the source generated by the coefficients, and use flatness and faithful flatness to conclude that A is everything (proof lines 31670-31677).
proof_roadmap: Take generators of the base change and collect their coefficients (proof lines 31668-31675).
Use faithful flatness to descend the equality (proof lines 31675-31678).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that finite type descends along a faithfully flat ring map (statement lines 31659-31666). The proof does not measure generating sets: it expands finitely many generators of the base change as finite sums, takes the subalgebra generated by the coefficients, and uses flatness to embed its base change and faithful flatness to conclude that it was everything (proof lines 31668-31678). Using faithful flatness to detect equality of subalgebras is the step that makes the descent work. H2.
